items.prompt: The public domain is 0 <= x,y < 2^63. Which boundary pair is legal and has the stated output?

options.why: Negative masks are outside the domain, so this is not a valid public fixture even if Python can evaluate it.
The upper bound is strict. A set bit at position 63 is outside this 63-bit domain.
Position 62 is the highest allowed bit, and its intersection has exactly one set bit.
The pair is legal, but its intersection has 63 set bits, an odd count.
